editions.lead: Wall Street ends mixed as Nvidia gives up its post-earnings gain and the Fed minutes sound hawkish
Futures jump as Nvidia's blowout quarter pulls AI and chip stocks higher after hours
Nvidia revenue jumps 103% to $115.8 billion and it guides to $130 billion in its first report since Huang left
Nvidia reports tonight with the first guide under Kress; the Street wants about $109 billion and steady margins
Nasdaq falls 2.5% and the S&P 500 drops 1.9% as AI stocks slide into Nvidia's first report without Huang
Trump and Xi are expected to meet at APEC in Shenzhen this week, with the trade truce already extended
Wall Street ends a volatile week higher as Nvidia drags the Nasdaq down 0.9% on Friday
